title: Sensors, Controllers, Alarms, Calibration & Data Quality
description: Specialist module covering representative sensors, calibration/verification, controller/alarm interpretation, data-quality failures and maintenance handoff.
learningOutcomes: Evaluate sensor representativeness and measurement quality using placement, shielding, verification history, colocated comparison and time-series behavior.
Distinguish verification, calibration, adjustment and protected servicing, and use only suitable verified references for measurement-quality decisions.
Interpret controller commands, alarms, interlocks and physical response as separate evidence layers rather than treating displayed status as proof of delivery.
Analyze missing, flat-lined, intermittent and contradictory data while preserving the original record and explicitly representing uncertainty.
Produce a maintenance/controls handoff that identifies device, time, command, observed response, affected process, verification already completed and safe authority boundary.
